name: loopmath-harness
description: Configure, start and watch a loopmath harness tune from Claude Code. Runs the loopmath CLI; makes no model call itself.

loopmath_bin.title: loopmath command
loopmath_bin.description: The loopmath executable the mod runs (a name on PATH or a full path).

config_path.title: Config file
config_path.description: The tune's config file; empty means loopmath-harness.toml in the session's folder.
